# Municipal Ordinance No. 03, Series of 2001

**Reclassifying the Position of Bookkeeper III to Senior Bookkeeper**

## Summary

This ordinance reclassifies the position of Bookkeeper III to Senior Bookkeeper within the Office of the Municipal Accountant in Pitogo, Quezon. This change aligns with Civil Service Commission circulars and aims to streamline the title with the scope of work. The reclassification includes adjusting the salary grade and incorporating the expenditure into the annual budget.

## Key Provisions

1.  Section 1. The position of Bookkeeper III is hereby reclassified as Senior Bookkeeper with Salary Grade 9 Step 4 under Item No. 2 of the Plantilla of Personnel Schedule.
2.  Section 2. The corresponding appropriation and other expenditures for Senior Bookkeeper will be included in the Annual Budget for the year 2001.
3.  Section 3. This ordinance shall take effect immediately upon approval.
4.  Section 4. Any ordinance or part thereof which is inconsistent with this ordinance is hereby repealed.
5.  Section 5. Approved by the [[Sangguniang Bayan]] of Pitogo, Quezon this 7th day of October, 2001.
